name: Ulti
summary: Hungary's three-player auction trick-taking game where soloist bids contracts and plays against two defenders.
rules_text: Three players use 32 cards. Dealer gives 5 each, 7 to player on right, then 5 each. That player discards two face-down as talon and bids. Auction: in turn, a player may pass or take talon, make a higher bid by total value and fewer components, then discard two new face-down cards. Auction ends when all pass. Talon counts for soloist if Simple matters. Soloist announces trump if needed. Doubling of individual components occurs after bidding until second trick is led, alternating teams. Play: 10 tricks, follow suit if possible, otherwise may trump. In trump games Ace and Ten are 10 each, last trick 10, marriage King+Over 20, 40 in trump. No-trump games Betli avoids tricks, Durchmars must win all. Combined bids score components independently, with Ulti requiring last trick with lowest trump.
